## 4.1 Formatting

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Home › Font changes the letters: the size, bold and the colour.
- Home › Paragraph changes a whole paragraph: the alignment and the line spacing.
- First you select the text, then you click the command.
- **Lab task:** Make the title of the library notice 20, bold and centred. What else looks better now?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/format-text.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/format-lab.html" poster="sims/format-lab.png" title="Format Lab: text and paragraph formatting" task="**Show:** select the title and click 20, B and centre, then 1.15 for the text. **Ask:** which buttons change only letters, and which change the whole paragraph?" >}}

## Try it 1 · Formatting

a) Where is the Bold command?
b) Where is the line spacing?
c) What must you do before you click Bold?

::: {.answer}
a) Home › Font
b) Home › Paragraph
c) Select the text.
:::

## 4.2 Styles

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A style is saved formatting with a name, such as Title or Heading 1.
- You change a style once, and all text with this style changes.
- The Navigation Pane shows the headings as a map of the document.
- **Lab task:** Give the five lines of the class trip their styles. What does the Navigation Pane show?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/styles.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · Style Lab

{{< sim file="sims/style-lab.html" poster="sims/style-lab.png" title="Style Lab: styles and the Navigation Pane" task="**Show:** give the lines Title, Heading 1 and Heading 2, then change the look of Heading 1. **Ask:** why do both main headings change at once?" >}}

## Try it 2 · Styles

a) Which style is right for "Our class trip", the name of the report?
b) Which style is right for "Morning", a smaller heading under "The plan"?
c) Why is a heading made bold and big by hand not in the Navigation Pane?

::: {.answer}
a) Title
b) Heading 2
c) It has no heading style, so Word sees normal text.
:::

## 4.3 Lists and tables

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A bulleted list is for things in no special order.
- A numbered list is for steps in an order.
- A table puts information in rows and columns, and its first row is the header row.
- **Lab task:** Insert a table with 2 columns and 5 rows for the bus plan. Which row names the columns?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/lists-tables.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · List and Table Lab

{{< sim file="sims/list-table-lab.html" poster="sims/list-table-lab.png" title="List and Table Lab: bullets, numbers and a table" task="**Show:** choose numbering for the steps and bullets for the things, then a 5 × 2 table. **Ask:** why does the bus plan need 2 columns and 5 rows?" >}}

## Try it 3 · List or table?

a) Should the steps to print a file be bullets or numbering?
b) A price list has 6 items, each with a price. How many rows does its table need with a header row?
c) Why should you not make columns with spaces?

::: {.answer}
a) numbering: the order matters
b) 7 rows (and 2 columns)
c) On another screen the columns move.
:::

## 4.4 Pictures

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Insert › Pictures adds a picture, for example from Stock Images.
- A picture keeps its shape when you drag a corner.
- Square wrapping lets the text flow around the picture, and alt text describes it.
- **Lab task:** Insert a Stock Image, choose Square and write its alt text. Who will hear the alt text?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/picture-wrap.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 4 · Pictures

a) How do you make a picture smaller and keep its shape?
b) Which wrapping lets the text flow around a picture?
c) Who needs the alt text of a picture?

::: {.answer}
a) Drag a corner.
b) Square
c) people who cannot see it
:::

## Game challenge · The Family Day notice

{{< sim file="sims/notice-maker.html" poster="sims/notice-maker.png" title="Notice Maker: Huda's Family Day notice" kind="game" task="**The story:** Huda must format the notice for the Sunrise Company Family Day. **Your task:** tap each part of the notice and choose the right tool, with as few wrong clicks as you can." >}}

## Try it 5 · Huda's notice (harder)

The facts: the notice has the title "Sunrise Family Day", the headings "The plan" and "What to bring", three things to bring, a bus plan with four times and a park picture.

a) Which tool is right for the bus plan with four times and activities?
b) Huda changes the colour of Heading 1 once. What happens to the two headings?
c) Which alt text is good for the park picture?

::: {.answer}
a) a table (2 columns, 5 rows)
b) Both headings change.
c) for example: "A green park with trees"
:::

## Summary

- Home › Font changes letters, and Home › Paragraph changes whole paragraphs.
- Styles format the headings with one click and make the Navigation Pane.
- Bullets are for things, numbering is for steps, and a table is for rows and columns.
- A picture keeps its shape when you drag a corner, and Square wrapping puts text around it.
- Alt text describes a picture for people who cannot see it.
